en.answer: If <<11852>> is no longer in the Graveyard when its effect resolves, the effect is not applied.
en.question: If the effect of <<11852>> that activates in the Graveyard is activated, but my opponent chains <<6980>> so that <<11852>> is no longer in the Graveyard, how does the effect resolve?
